headline: Executive order sets rules for how federal agencies handle court orders to take money from federal workers' paychecks to pay debts.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with garnishment, which is when part of a worker's pay is held back to pay a debt under a legal order. It covers how this process applies to people who work for the federal government. No summary was provided, so the exact details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Part of their pay may be withheld to pay debts when a valid legal order requires it.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses owed money by federal employees
who_it_affects.how: They may be able to collect debts through garnishment of a federal worker's pay.
They are expected to process garnishment orders against their employees' pay.
